title: Field Service Software Pricing Tracker (Nov 2026): 24 Tools
description: Published prices for 24 field service apps (Jobber, Housecall Pro, GorillaDesk, Skimmer and more): starting price, billing unit, free plans, fees and changes.
h1: Field service software pricing tracker: 24 tools, sourced and dated
body:
This tracker lists the published price of every field service app we cover on TradeStackGuide: 24 tools for pool service, pest control, lawn care, window cleaning, pressure washing and general service trades. Each row comes from the vendor’s own pricing page and shows the date we last checked it. If a vendor doesn’t publish a number, we write unknown or “not published” rather than guess. All prices are USD unless marked (Squeegee only publishes GBP), and exclude tax, add-ons and card processing unless stated. Rows were re-checked between 2026-11-11 and 2026-11-14.

Want a cost for a specific team size? See field service software cost for 1 vs 5 users. For one trade, see the pool service, lawn care and pest control cost guides.

All tools: starting prices, billing units and fees

{{pricing_tracker}}

Price changes we’ve logged

  • 2026-11-14: Service Fusion raised its prices. Starter went from $245/mo to $259/mo month-to-month ($208 to $220/mo billed annually). Plus went from $382 to $399/mo ($325 to $339 annually), and Pro from $627 to $649/mo ($533 to $552 annually). Every plan still includes unlimited users (servicefusion.com/pricing, previous prices checked 2026-11-07).
  • 2026-11-14: ClockShark prices are now visible. The pricing page shows Standard at $42/mo + $9.50/mo per active user and Pro at $63/mo + $11.50/mo per active user (USD). A three-year contract term applies to all plans (clockshark.com/pricing).
  • 2026-11-14: no change for ResponsiBid, Workiz, Yardbook, Service Autopilot, LMN, Kickserv, ServiceM8 or Homeworks. LMN’s page shows a sale that ends November 30 (“4 months free of LMN and Greenius”), which we leave out of the prices because it’s time-limited (granum.com/lmn/pricing).
  • 2026-11-12: GorillaDesk Growth is listed at $499/mo total for 5 routes, then +$50 per extra route.
  • 2026-10-30: Jobber’s first-year promo ended, and its list prices apply again (Jobber pricing).

How each tool charges you

The plan price is only half the story. What you pay as you grow depends on what the vendor counts, so compare tools that bill the same way.

  • Per pool or location: Skimmer charges $1 per serviced location with a $49/mo minimum, and UpBuoy Professional charges $3 per location with a $99/mo minimum (free for up to 3 locations). Your bill grows with your route, not your headcount. See Skimmer pricing.
  • Per field tech: Pool Brain is $50/mo base + $65/mo per field tech, and Paythepoolman is $50/mo base + $15/mo per tech. Office users are included. See Skimmer vs Pool Brain.
  • Per route: GorillaDesk Basic is $49/mo for 1 route with free users. Extra routes are added at the prices in the table.
  • Per user: QuoteIQ ($29.99/mo + $25/mo per extra user), Pool Office Manager ($125/mo + $25/mo per extra user), Squeegee (£19/mo per user + VAT) and ClockShark (base + per active user). Jobber adds users at $29/mo each, Homeworks at $15/mo per seat, and Housecall Pro lists $35/mo per extra user on MAX. See Housecall Pro pricing.
  • Users bundled into tiers: Kickserv includes 5, 10 or 20 users per plan, and Homeworks Growth up to 10. LawnPro includes 0, 3, 7 or 15 employee logins. Service Autopilot and LMN sell office and mobile/crew licenses per plan. See LMN pricing.
  • Unlimited users: Service Fusion includes unlimited users on every plan. ServiceM8 paid plans include unlimited users but are priced by jobs per month (50 on Starter, 150 on Growing). ResponsiBid Scaling and Pro allow unlimited sub-users with 1 admin.
  • Providers or storage: BookingKoala prices by providers (each team member counts) or monthly storage.
  • Quote only: Workiz, FieldRoutes and PestPac don’t publish plan prices. FieldRoutes says its subscription is based on your number of active customers. Service Autopilot Elite and LMN Enterprise are also “contact for pricing.”

Free plans (not just trials)

Six tools publish a free plan with limits: ResponsiBid Startup (1 admin user), Yardbook Starter, ServiceM8 Free (1 user, 30 jobs/mo), LawnPro Solo (1 user, up to 25 customers), Homeworks Solo, and UpBuoy Essential (up to 3 locations). Free plans can carry other costs. Yardbook adds a 1% fee on top of Stripe fees for free/trial accounts, and Homeworks Solo card processing is 3.9% + 30¢. More detail: free pool service software and Yardbook vs Jobber.

Fees the plan price leaves out

  • Setup and onboarding fees: ResponsiBid charges a one-time setup fee, LMN a one-time onboarding fee, and Service Autopilot lists “+ sign up fee” on its plans. None of the three publishes the amount. Pool Office Manager and Paythepoolman say they charge no setup or activation fee.
  • Annual prepay: discounts include Jobber (Core $29/mo annual vs $49 monthly), Kickserv (save 20%), Service Fusion (save 15%, charged as one payment), QuoteIQ (12 months for the price of 10) and Homeworks (Growth $219/mo annual vs $299). Jobber’s annual prepay is non-refundable, and Kickserv’s annual plans aren’t pro-rated or refundable.
  • Contracts: ClockShark applies a three-year contract term to all plans. Service Autopilot publishes annual subscription rates only. Most others are month-to-month.
  • Card processing: published rates include Jobber 2.9% + 30¢ online, Kickserv 3.9% + 30¢ (2.9% + 30¢ Tap to Pay), ServiceM8 Pay 3.05% + 30¢ domestic, and Housecall Pro from 2.59%. Many vendors don’t publish their rate (unknown in the table).

Before you sign, run through the field service software buying checklist. To price your own jobs, try the job quote estimator. Trade hubs: pool service, pest control, lawn care, window cleaning, pressure washing.

How we keep this current

Every row is built from the same data as the individual tool pages, so when we re-check a vendor, its row and verified date update here too. We don’t publish ratings or reviews, and time-limited promos are noted but left out of the prices. Corrections: jacob@tradestackguide.com. Read our methodology.
faq: How much does field service software cost per month?

Of the 24 tools we track (checked 2026-11-11 to 2026-11-14), published entry prices run from free plans (ResponsiBid, Yardbook, ServiceM8, LawnPro, Homeworks, UpBuoy) to $297/mo for LMN Starter plus an onboarding fee. Common paid starting points are Jobber Core at $49/mo monthly ($29/mo billed annually), QuoteIQ at $29.99/mo, GorillaDesk at $49/mo for 1 route and Housecall Pro Basic at $79/mo monthly ($59/mo billed annually). Workiz, FieldRoutes and PestPac don't publish prices.
Which field service software has a free plan?

ResponsiBid Startup (1 admin user), Yardbook Starter, ServiceM8 Free (1 user, 30 jobs a month), LawnPro Solo (1 user, up to 25 customers), Homeworks Solo and UpBuoy Essential (up to 3 locations), per each vendor's pricing page (checked 2026-11-11 to 2026-11-14).
Did any field service software prices change recently?

Yes. On 2026-11-14 Service Fusion's pricing page showed Starter at $259/mo month-to-month ($220/mo billed annually), up from $245 ($208) when we checked on 2026-11-07. Plus and Pro also went up. ResponsiBid, Workiz, Yardbook, Service Autopilot, LMN, Kickserv, ServiceM8 and Homeworks were unchanged that day.
Which field service software doesn't publish its prices?

Workiz (Request pricing on all plans), FieldRoutes (quote only, priced by number of active customers) and PestPac (modular packages through a consultant). Service Autopilot Elite and LMN Enterprise are also contact-for-pricing.
Which field service software includes unlimited users?

Service Fusion includes unlimited users on every plan. ServiceM8's paid plans include unlimited users but are priced by jobs per month. GorillaDesk users are free, with billing by route. Skimmer users are unlimited, with billing per serviced location.
